The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Phaegon III''' was in the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Its [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]] was the main source of [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] ordered that the Lignan be [[Mining/Legends|mined]], and [[Saes Rrogon]] and [[Yaru Korsin]] led a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] force to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] shortly before the [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Kirrek]].
